label: prop:alpha-shift-torus-knot
title: Pole order at $q=0$ of the torus-knot character: $\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{p,k}) = k(p-1)$ on $V_{(1^p)}$
html:
Proposition. Pole order at q=0 of the torus-knot character: \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{p,k}) = k(p-1) on V_{(1^p)}

Proposition (torus-knot \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}). Let p \geq 1, k \geq 1 with \gcd(p, k) = 1, and let T_{p,k} be the (p, k)-torus knot, presented as the closure of the braid \beta_{p,k} = (\sigma_1 \sigma_2 \cdots \sigma_{p-1})^k \in B_p. Define the shift exponent

  \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{p,k})
  \;:=\;
  \max_{\lambda \,\vdash\, p}\;
  \mathrm{ord}_{q=0}^{(-)}\; \chi_\lambda(\beta_{p,k})

where \chi_\lambda is the seminormal Hecke character on V_\lambda (def:delta-q-decoration) and \mathrm{ord}_{q=0}^{(-)} denotes the pole order at q = 0 (i.e. the negative of the Laurent valuation). Then:

  1. The maximizer is the all-anti-symmetric channel V_{(1^p)}.
  2. \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{p,k}) = k(p - 1).

Witness summary

The canonical evidence (alpha-shift-torus.witness.json) records the full per-irrep symbolic \chi_\lambda \in \mathbb{Q}(q) together with the pole order at q = 0 for every test pair, summarised in Table: \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{p,k}) for 6 test pairs. All 14 assertions in the witness pass.

Cross-link

The two values \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9}) = 9 and \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5}) = 10 are precisely the q-integer indices appearing in prop:em-coupling-projection's formula

  \alpha_{EM}^{-1} \;=\; q \cdot [9]_q \cdot [10]_q.

prop:alpha-em-shift-multiplicative-chain combines the two identities into the shift-exponent form

  \alpha_{EM}^{-1}
  \;=\;
  q \cdot
  \bigl[\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9})\bigr]_q \cdot
  \bigl[\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5})\bigr]_q,

recasting the \delta_q-trace identity in the same combinatorial terms as the atomic-shift formula.
